title: The loop runs into a full disk: no preflight halts on low free space, so a system failure reaches lanes as code FAILs
summary: Wave 27 (2026-09-28) went 0/2 on a host with 143 MiB free of 460 GiB. 1739's ship backstop failed on `TempDir: … no space left on device`, 1740's audit failed its integration-tier gate, and both read as code failures that nearly reset a ship streak. Neither the boot preflight nor the wave boundary checks free space. See docs/incidents/2026-09-28-the-disk-filled-and-two-lanes-failed-for-it.md.
fix: Add a `disk-space` check to internal/looppreflight (the boot halts with a Signal Center code and the operator's fix: `evolve gc`) and run the same check at each wave boundary before launching a wave. The floor is config (policy.json, e.g. preflight.min_free_gib), never a Go literal. A failing check is a system halt (ADR-0072), never a lane verdict.
acceptance: A boot on a host below the floor halts with the named check and fix (red on an injected statfs)
A wave boundary below the floor stops the run before launching the next wave
The floor comes from policy.json with a documented default; runtime-reference.md lists it
